rules.description: R1: every email code send on accounts.later.dog (sign-in and password reset), 3 per 10 min per IP
rules.expression: (http.host eq "accounts.later.dog" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp" "/api/auth/email-otp/request-password-reset" "/api/auth/forget-password/email-otp"})

response.content: {"code":"TOO_MANY_REQUESTS","message":"Too many sign-in codes from this network. Wait 10 minutes, then try again."}

rules.description: R2: email code checks on accounts.later.dog, 10 per 10 min per IP
rules.expression: (http.host eq "accounts.later.dog" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/sign-in/email-otp")

response.content: {"code":"TOO_MANY_REQUESTS","message":"Too many sign-in tries from this network. Wait 10 minutes, then try again."}

rules.description: R3: trial starts on cloud.later.dog (app and web form), 3 per 10 min per IP
rules.expression: (http.host eq "cloud.later.dog" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/trials/start" "/trial"})

response.content: {"error":{"code":"rate_limited","message":"Too many trials from this network. Wait 10 minutes, then try again."}}

rules.description: R4: cloud.later.dog except the keyed routes Cloud homes call (included AI, voice, decision, computers, trial and plan status; homes share egress addresses and the Worker limits those per key), 300 per minute per IP
rules.expression: (http.host eq "cloud.later.dog" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/ai/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/voice/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/computers/") and not http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/complete" "/v1/systemone" "/v1/computers" "/v1/trial" "/v1/plan"})

response.content: {"error":{"code":"rate_limited","message":"Too many requests from this network. Wait a minute, then try again."}}

rules.description: R5: every Cloud home (*-home.later.dog), 600 per minute per IP

response.content: {"error":{"code":"rate_limited","message":"Too many requests from this network. Wait a minute, then try again."}}
